segments.speaker: Diễn giả 1
segments.text: Now listen carefully and answer questions 21 to 26.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Right, now you wanted to organise a formal discussion of some sort in the class, is that right, Daniel?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Yes, we thought it would be really good to end our psychology course with a formal debate.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: You know, where there's a statement and people argue for or against it?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Good idea.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Where did the enthusiasm come from?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Have either of you organised debates before, Fiona?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: No, but one of my friends did in his last year at secondary school and he says he got a lot out of doing it.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: And I know they have debates in lots of other departments here at the university.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: I see.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: So what do you think the students, you and the others, would get out of this?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: Well, a debate will encourage people to study all sides of the subject matter.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: And I also think listening to other people's ideas can have a focusing effect on your own.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: Sometimes you kind of don't know what you truly believe until you hear something you disagree with.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: OK, what about the topic for the debate?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: We've got three to choose from.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: We'll show you in a minute to check they're OK.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: At first we thought we'd ask the other students to suggest something, but we were afraid we'd get 30 different topics.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: So instead we brainstormed some, just the two of us, then made a shortlist, and we'll get them to vote for the one they like best.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Right.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: But the thing is, if people don't know how debates work, they could feel at a disadvantage.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: I mean, it wouldn't affect their grades or anything, but it could put them off.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: So we thought we should have a meeting beforehand to make sure everyone's clear about what's involved in a debate and how to prepare for it.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: I think that's a good idea.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: And we thought we could establish some key points of a successful debate there, like that debates are effective methods for considering an issue and that you need to understand both sides of an argument in order to support one side effectively.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: We think it'll be best if we can use an issue that the students already have strong opinions about.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Then some people will be happy to speak in support of it and others to oppose it.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Right.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: What else do you want to do at the meeting?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Well, we've got to think about how people will do the background research for the debate.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: We could organise everyone into two teams.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: That should save time for the main speakers.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: They won't have to do it on their own.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: And we'll need to decide on some rules.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: like how long each person speaks for, and to select a chair for the debate, someone who's really confident.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Fine.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Now I think you should have some sort of follow-up to the debate.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: After it's over, I'd like you to get everyone to write a short essay, focusing on what they gain from participating in it.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: And in turn, that can feed into the work we've been doing on learning and motivation.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: Would you be willing to read them and report back?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: I mean, give some feedback on them.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: I wouldn't have made the suggestion if I wasn't.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: Thanks.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 1
segments.text: Before you hear the rest of the discussion, you have some time to look at questions 27 to 30.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 1
segments.text: Now listen and answer questions 27 to 30.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: OK, now let's think a bit more about the meeting.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: You need to decide exactly how you'll introduce the students to different features of a debate.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Well, first of all, we need to inform everyone about what actually happens at a debate, the procedures and so on.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: We could talk about that and write the main information on the board.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: Or instead of that, we could make a summary of the main stages and hand that out.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Then talk it through.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Yes, OK, that's better.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: OK, but we do need to talk about body language as well.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Yes, that's a very important tool.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: I've got an interesting article on that with some good diagrams of techniques for things like eye contact.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: I'll make some copies for you to give out.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Great.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Then we need to think about where people will find the information on the debate topic.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: So they'll need to know where to look for the information.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: We could compile a list of sources, textbooks and articles and so on.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: We could.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: But couldn't people offer their own suggestions and advice on that at the meeting instead?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: Yes, get everyone involved.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Right.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: What about preparation for asking and answering questions?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: We could try to demonstrate that, but I'm not sure how.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 3
segments.text: Maybe we could put up a list of points on the board, then discuss them?

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: Yes, that sounds better.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 4
segments.text: Thanks.

segments.speaker: Diễn giả 2
segments.text: OK, well, let's meet up again.

segments.text: That is the end of Part Three you now have 30 seconds to check your answers to Part Three.
